AI Overview
Friday Night Funkin'
Video game
Friday Night Funkin' is an open-source rhythm video game created by ninjamuffin99, PhantomArcade, Kawai Sprite, and evilsk8r. 
Wikipedia
 +1
Gameplay and Story
You play as Boyfriend, a character trying to win the approval of Girlfriend's rockstar father, Daddy Dearest, and other opponents through singing and rapping. 
Wikipedia
 +1
The mechanic requires hitting directional arrows on your keyboard or gamepad in time with the music to match the opponent's singing. 
itch.io
 +1
You must manage a health bar by keeping up with the rhythm and avoiding too many missed notes. 
Wikipedia
 +1
Platforms and Availability
The game is available to play on web browsers via platforms like Newgrounds, or downloaded for free on Itch.io.
Official mobile versions are available on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
The game is open-source, which has inspired a massive community modding scene.
